body:
Good morning, Bakersfield. It’s Tuesday, August 25, 2026, and we’re starting the day with a high of 102° and air quality at a moderate 54. Overnight, officers responded to a possible attempted abduction near Union Avenue and Columbus Street, and today we’re following the community’s response to the tragic shooting at Independence High School. Let’s get you caught up.

## The Kern Overnight

Overnight activity kept officers busy across Bakersfield, with a notable incident unfolding shortly before 11 p.m. near Union Avenue and Columbus Street. A caller reported two men in an older tan Toyota Camry attempting to get an 18-year-old woman into their vehicle. Officers searched the area as the vehicle was last seen heading northbound on Union Avenue. Into the early hours of Tuesday, police also responded to a disturbance on the 2800 block of C Street, where a subject was reported in possession of a butcher knife while the reporting party stayed barricaded in a bathroom. Elsewhere, officers pursued a minibike at low speed through east Bakersfield, with the chase moving westbound on Oregon Street, northbound on Gage Avenue, and across Niles Street at speeds between roughly 15 and 37 mph. Around 3:15 a.m., a unit began tracking a 2017 Nissan that refused to stop in east Bakersfield. And around 12:30 a.m., a woman reported her ex-boyfriend threw a brick through her vehicle and patio door on Coventry Drive, with officers investigating the incident.

## Today's weather

Expect a high near 102° today with a low around 75° tonight. It’s currently 75° at Meadows Field (KBFL). There are no active weather alerts for Kern County, and air quality is holding at a moderate 54. Conditions should remain calm and clear as we move through the day.

## Top stories

**23ABC reports that the Bakersfield community gathered Monday night at the Dignity Health Sports Complex for an evening of prayer and music to remember 17-year-old Levi Brown, who was killed outside an Independence High School football game Friday night.** Bakersfield police say the shooting was gang-related, and a 15-year-old suspect was arrested Saturday. On Monday, police announced six more arrests, including three teens, as officers worked to prevent potential retaliatory gang violence. Police say those arrests are not directly connected to Brown’s homicide. Bakersfield Chief of Police Brent Stratton spoke Monday morning about the shooting’s ties to gang activity, noting that the age range of those involved in such incidents is unfortunately common. Manuel Carrizalez, founder and director of Stay Focused Ministries, knew Brown through his organization, which mentors teens and other students through school visits and office meetings. Carrizalez said Brown had a lot of goals and was looking towards his future.

**KGET 17 tells us that the California State Parks Foundation is now accepting submissions for its 2026 Photo Contest.** Take a picture at one of California’s 280 state parks and submit it online at CalParks.org. You can enter up to three photos in each of the following five categories: Scenic Landscapes, Wildlife & Nature, Recreation & Activities, People in Parks, and California History. Winners will receive a free membership to the California State Parks Foundation and will be featured in the Foundation’s 2028 calendar. It’s free to enter, and submissions will be accepted through September 21.

## Something good

The Bridal Quince Expo in Bakersfield is set for September, offering a celebration of local culture and traditions. This event provides an opportunity for the community to come together and enjoy a festive occasion.

## Coming up this week

Looking ahead, there are several events and meetings on the calendar. On Wednesday, August 26, a Special City Council Meeting is set for 12:00 p.m., followed by a City Council Meeting at 3:30 p.m. and another at 5:15 p.m. At the Fox Theater, the Cults & Classics: Season Pass 2026-2027 is available now, with Rodney Carrington performing on Thursday, August 27. On Friday, August 28, CUMBIATRON: THE CUMBIA RAVE takes the stage, and on Saturday, August 29, Willie Barcena and Michael Return Of The King Tribute Featuring Michael Phoenix will perform. Finally, on Saturday, September 4, the MI HISTORIA TOUR LEYENDAS DEL MARIACHI USA will be at the Fox Theater.
